summary: Frontend-only test of the 1.000₺ free-shipping text, the floating WhatsApp button, WhatsApp numbers, cookie banner position and guest checkout notice layout. All items passed at mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x800.

issues: The cookie banner sits at top:132px and covers the hero badge '1.000₺ üzeri kargo bedava' until the user taps 'Anladım'. This matches the requested design, so it is cosmetic only.

verified: Home hero badge DOM text '1.000₺ üzeri kargo bedava'. No '500 TL/₺' shipping text on Home, product, cart or checkout. Product page shows '1.000₺ ve üzeri kargo bedava'. Checkout shows '₺1.000,00 ve üzeri ücretsiz, altında ₺200,00'. Backend FREE_SHIPPING_LIMIT=1000.

whatsapp-fab is visible and on top (elementFromPoint) on /, /kategori/tumu, /urun/<id>, /sepet, /odeme, /sayfa/iletisim, /sign-in (guest) and /favorilerim, /admin (admin). Mobile: right 16px, bottom 80px (136px on the product page). It does not overlap mobile-bottom-nav, sticky-add-bar or cookie-banner. Desktop: 24px/24px. href starts with https://wa.me/905389493567?text=

cart-whatsapp-button, checkout-whatsapp-link and contact-whatsapp-link all use wa.me/905389493567. The contact page shows 'Telefon: 0538 949 35 67'. GET /api/settings/public returns whatsapp_number 905389493567.
Cookie banner: desktop bottom-left (x16, y638, w384), does not touch the FAB at x1840. Mobile: top 132px.
Guest notice at 390px: text span is full width (284px, 3 lines), and the Giriş Yap / Üye Ol buttons wrap onto their own row below it.
Regression: guest add to cart through sticky-add-to-cart works. Cart 119 + 200 shipping = 319 with an '881 daha ekle' hint. Checkout toggle mağaza → total 119; adres → total 319.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppFab hardcodes the mobile bottom offsets (80px / 136px) to match the BottomNav and sticky-bar heights. If those components change height, the FAB could end up overlapping them.
